_what_this_is: Checked-in eval cases for scene decomposition. tests/test_decompose.py runs RuleBasedDecomposer against each brief and asserts shot count and camera moves.

cases.name: single-beat tracking
cases.brief: Gwen walks slowly through a rainy neon market, worried, camera tracks from behind

cases.name: three beats with push-in
cases.brief: Gwen enters a dim warehouse. She pauses, anxious. The camera pushes in as she opens the crate.

cases.name: sprint then pan
cases.brief: Gwen sprints across the rooftop rapidly. The camera pans to reveal the city skyline.

cases.name: semicolon split, static
cases.brief: Gwen sits by a window; rain streaks down the glass outside

cases.name: two camera phases split into two shots
cases.brief: Gwen walks slowly through a rainy neon market at night, worried, the camera tracks her from behind then swings around to her face

cases.name: orbit then brisk exit
cases.brief: The camera orbits Gwen as she stands determined on the cliff edge. She turns and walks away briskly.
